verdict.rationale: Lambda ships a live, key-gated REST API with a published OpenAPI spec for creating and managing Cloud resources. Documented coverage includes launching and restarting instances, launch-time options (alternative base images, cloud-init) and creating workspaces. However, several documented workflows are described only through the console UI: firewall rules on the Firewall page, SSH key generation, reserving 1-Click Clusters and viewing usage. Full UI parity is therefore unproven. Missing for 10: evidence that firewall rules, SSH key management, 1CC reservation and usage/billing views are exposed via the API, and an explicit API-parity statement or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
You can also restart instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
If you launch your instance using the Lambda Cloud API, you can choose to use an alternative base image instead.
